findings.finding: Complete but inconsistent inference was counted as operational readiness.
findings.before: Actual worker result inconsistent, complete=true, trusted=false but aggregate ready=true.

findings.finding: A current-context manifest with omitted outputs could hide missing required artifacts.
findings.before: Compile manifest outputs={} with both compiled files deleted still reported required compile current and aggregate ready=true.
findings.fix: Check schema, matching operation, nonempty output mapping and exact current expected output set; changed input context remains stale.

findings.finding: The workbench probe socket inactivity timeout did not impose a total network deadline.
findings.before: A 0.05-second selected budget returned after 0.753 seconds while a local audit server trickled bytes.
findings.fix: Apply a monotonic remaining network budget with a transient timer shutting down the owned socket; cancel/join timer in cleanup and classify timeout.

findings.finding: Malformed URL syntax raised an uncaught ValueError.
findings.before: advanced-health --workbench-url http://[ returned traceback, empty stdout and exit 1.
findings.fix: Convert URL/port parse ValueError to invalid_service; CLI emits invalid JSON and exit 2.

checks.actual_inference: Pinned certified disposable runtime, including a valid baseline and inconsistent authored extension.
checks.service_probes: Audit-owned loopback servers trickled response headers/body; both bounded timeouts and owned cleanup passed.
checks.no_write: Regression tests compare fixture bytes and persistent mtimes around each health/CLI/probe path.

limitations: Bounded independent source review and focused regressions. Complete integrated guard-owner, delivered-installation, model/index and final live root acceptance remain host responsibilities. No production mutation or nested delegation was performed.
stopping_condition: Actionable findings reported, host fixes reinspected, all retained discriminating regressions passed; reviewed test source frozen.
